name: LValueData.map_trivialLift
summary: A σ-semilinear conjugation L of data (`Parameters.exists_semilinear_isJetConjugate`) conjugates the jets of the kernel data place by place; applied term by term to the class sums defining Ξ_X and Ξ_Y (Ξ_Y translated by the scalar z⁻¹), it gives the formula.

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: lines 15–19 are the rest of the statement, which ends before the `:=` on line 19 (a second-reader message). The line census takes the `:=` of `let Y :=` on line 15 for the start of the value, so the check requires these lines to be owned here. They state: Y = LValueData(S, jetDeg(X)∘e⁻¹, μ, ψ, is, …, unr); if |n| = 2m, placePerm(s, σ) = e and μ(u′) = σ(μ_X(u′)) at every u′ with trivial infinite component, then for all h, i: σ((jetScale(P, s)^{∑_τ dg_τ}·trivialLift(X))(h)_i) = t^{∑_τ dg_τ}·(l·b(auxPair(Y))(u))·multiplierRatio(σ, onHom(1, 1, h)₂)·trivialLift(Y)(h)_{i∘e⁻¹}, dg = jetDeg(X).
steps.lean:
LValueData _ n} {e μ ψ m} is unr, X.1 = S → let Y := (mk X.1 (X.jetDeg <|
    e.symm ·) μ ψ is X.one_lt_card unr); Fintype.card n = 2 * m → placePerm s σ = e → (∀ u, u.1.1 =
    1 → μ.1 u = σ (X.μ.1 u)) → ∀ h i, σ ((P.jetScale s ^ (∑ τ, X.jetDeg τ) • X.trivialLift) h i) =
    (t ^ ∑ τ, X.jetDeg τ) * (l * Y.auxPair.b.1 u) * multiplierRatio σ (onHom (s :=
    X.auxPair.signs) (s' := 1) (1, 1, h)).2 * Y.trivialLift h (i <| e.symm ·) := by

steps.claim: The σ-semilinear conjugation of data on Hom(I₁, I_n) (`Parameters.exists_semilinear_isJetConjugate`, the places of S being disjoint from their conjugates): t with |t|² = Ω⁻¹ (T), l ≠ 0 (hl), z, and L conjugating jets (h1), compatible with the Weil action and with named data.
steps.lean:
choose t l z L T hl h1 _ using exists_semilinear_isJetConjugate ((stdSpace _ Unit).hom
    (stdSpace _ n)) (R := S.places) (by grind [S.7.2]) σ

steps.claim: Take t, l and u (found below): |t| = Ω^{−1/2} from T, l ≠ 0, and the formula as follows.
steps.lean:
exact ⟨t, l, _, by simpa using congr(√$T), hl, by
  introv a Y hm he hb; subst a; simp [↓Y.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate (scalarFin _ z⁻¹),
    trivialLift, apply_eq_evalForm, classSum, mul_sum,
    map_rat_smul, -MonoidHom.coe_range]; congr! 2 with g
  have := congr((schurJet
    _ $((he ▸ h1) _ (pairWeilFinite _ _ 1 X.auxPair.b (g.out, h) X.auxPair.auxDatum).2) *ᵥ 1) i)
  rw [(_ : L _ = (_ : ℂ) • _), (_ : ∀ F, schurJet _ (.rename _ F) =
    (schurJet Y.auxPair.κ F).submatrix (e.piCongrLeft' _) (e.piCongrLeft' _)),
    submatrix_mulVec_equiv, schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul Y.isLiftWeight] at this
  with_unfolding_all simpa [↓← apply_eq_evalForm, kernelForm, kernelValue, entrywise, ← map_schurJet
                       X.isLiftWeight, AuxPair.κ, mul_sum, mixedWeight, Y, X.one_lt_card, boxes,
    schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul X.isLiftWeight (jetScale ..), mul_assoc (_ ^ _), Equiv.sum_comp]
  intro; ext; apply jet_rename (Equiv.prodCongr _ 1).toEmbedding
  rw [map_schur Y.isLiftWeight.1, schur_apply_eq_prod X.isLiftWeight.1, ← e.symm.prod_comp,
    schur_apply_eq_prod Y.isLiftWeight.1]; simp; rfl
  simp_rw [pairWeilFinite_apply_apply_coe, pairWeil_apply]
  rw [show G.onHom ((_, _ * _), _) = _ by simpa using ((map_mul _ ((1, _), 1, h) _).trans
      congr(_ * $(onHom_scalarFin z⁻¹ 1))), onHom_fin, ← fst_mul_snd (_, _)]
  simp only [map_smulₛₗ, snd_mul, ← one_mk_mul_one_mk, mul_apply_eq_comp, *, omega_mem_finitePart,
    smul_smul,
    AuxPair.auxDatum, places_levelModulus, liftFn_eq_residueDatum, isSchwartzBruhat_residueDatum _
    X.apart.2, name_mem_finitePart _ _ vacElem_mem_finitePart, pairChar_apply, map_mul]
  congr 1; erw [multiplierRatio, finMultiplier_onHom_left, map_pow, ← div_pow, hm, pow_mul,
    multiplierRatio_sq, detFin, map_inv _ (1, _)]
  simp [rankTwist, *, funext_iff, mul_pow, field]
  congr with; simp [univ_eq_empty, residueDatum, AuxPair.resDetDatum, apply_ite σ]⟩

steps.claim: Given X with places S, e, μ, ψ, …: write Ξ_Y as the class sum of its kernel forms translated by the scalar z⁻¹ (`LValueData.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate`) and Ξ_X as its class sum; σ commutes with the rational class sum; compare the terms of each class g.
steps.lean:
introv a Y hm he hb; subst a; simp [↓Y.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate (scalarFin _ z⁻¹),
    trivialLift, apply_eq_evalForm, classSum, mul_sum,
    map_rat_smul, -MonoidHom.coe_range]; congr! 2 with g

steps.claim: Apply the jet conjugation h1 (with e) to the datum Υ moved by (g, h): the Schur jets of L(moved Υ) are the σ-conjugates of those of the moved Υ, up to the scale t and the permutation e.
steps.lean:
have := congr((schurJet
    _ $((he ▸ h1) _ (pairWeilFinite _ _ 1 X.auxPair.b (g.out, h) X.auxPair.auxDatum).2) *ᵥ 1) i)

steps.claim: Rewrite: L(moved Υ) is a scalar times the moved Υ of Y (shown below); Schur jets of renamed series are submatrices (shown below); pull the scale out of the jets (`schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul`).
steps.lean:
rw [(_ : L _ = (_ : ℂ) • _), (_ : ∀ F, schurJet _ (.rename _ F) =
    (schurJet Y.auxPair.κ F).submatrix (e.piCongrLeft' _) (e.piCongrLeft' _)),
    submatrix_mulVec_equiv, schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul Y.isLiftWeight] at this

steps.claim: This is the term identity for the class g (unfolding kernelForm, kernelValue and the weights; sums reindexed by e).
steps.lean:
with_unfolding_all simpa [↓← apply_eq_evalForm, kernelForm, kernelValue, entrywise, ← map_schurJet
                       X.isLiftWeight, AuxPair.κ, mul_sum, mixedWeight, Y, X.one_lt_card, boxes,
    schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul X.isLiftWeight (jetScale ..), mul_assoc (_ ^ _), Equiv.sum_comp]

steps.claim: Renaming the variables by the place permutation commutes with jets (`jet_rename`).
The Schur polynomials of X and Y correspond under e (products over places reindexed, `schur_apply_eq_prod`).
steps.lean:
rw [map_schur Y.isLiftWeight.1, schur_apply_eq_prod X.isLiftWeight.1, ← e.symm.prod_comp,
    schur_apply_eq_prod Y.isLiftWeight.1]; simp; rfl

steps.claim: Rewrite the point of the Weil action.
steps.lean:
rw [show G.onHom ((_, _ * _), _) = _ by simpa using ((map_mul _ ((1, _), 1, h) _).trans
      congr(_ * $(onHom_scalarFin z⁻¹ 1))), onHom_fin, ← fst_mul_snd (_, _)]

steps.claim: The point onHom((g, h·scalar), …) is onHom((1, 1, h)) times the scalar point (`onHom_scalarFin`, `onHom_fin`).
steps.lean:
show G.onHom ((_, _ * _), _) = _ by simpa using ((map_mul _ ((1, _), 1, h) _).trans
      congr(_ * $(onHom_scalarFin z⁻¹ 1))), onHom_fin, ← fst_mul_snd (_, _)]

steps.claim: L commutes with the Weil action up to multiplierRatio and sends the named datum Υ to l times the moved named datum of σ∘(its residue function) (the last parts of `Parameters.exists_semilinear_isJetConjugate`, Υ being Schwartz–Bruhat at S).
steps.lean:
simp only [map_smulₛₗ, snd_mul, ← one_mk_mul_one_mk, mul_apply_eq_comp, *, omega_mem_finitePart,
    smul_smul,
    AuxPair.auxDatum, places_levelModulus, liftFn_eq_residueDatum, isSchwartzBruhat_residueDatum _
    X.apart.2, name_mem_finitePart _ _ vacElem_mem_finitePart, pairChar_apply, map_mul]

steps.claim: The multiplier ratio at the scalar point is a power of a square (`multiplierRatio_sq`), with |n| = 2m.
steps.lean:
congr 1; erw [multiplierRatio, finMultiplier_onHom_left, map_pow, ← div_pow, hm, pow_mul,
    multiplierRatio_sq, detFin, map_inv _ (1, _)]

steps.claim: The character b(Y) at u matches (rankTwist, μ = σ∘μ_X).
The residue function of Y is σ of that of X (without twist places the product over Q is empty).
steps.lean: congr with; simp [univ_eq_empty, residueDatum, AuxPair.resDetDatum, apply_ite σ]⟩
